# Front matter after a byte order mark

The YAML block above starts right after the byte order mark. It shows as
the properties strip, and no empty paragraph sits between the strip and
this heading.

- A bullet with *emphasis* and `inline code`
- [ ] A task item

| Property | Shown as |
| --- | --- |
| title | Large text |
| tags | Chips |

> A quote with a [link](https://example.com/bom).

```text
A code block.
```
